prompt.alinti: Someone just open-sourced a tool that runs thousands of fake customers through your launch, and 72,000 people have started. It fills a fake internet with a few thousand people who each have their own job, their own mood, their own reason to care. They argue with each other round after round, opinions move, and at the end you get a write-up of how it lands.
